result.title: Reactive Optimizers
result.comment: This document is a static version of our blog post. We recommend the original interactive version at https://xingjianbai.com/reactive-optimizers/. We release the code at https://github.com/xingjian-bai/opal
result.summary: We study a reactive optimizer that uses a pretrained language-model agent to inspect training dynamics and rewrite executable optimizer code during a single training run. The agent can change update rules and schedules for individual parameter groups, without optimizer-specific meta-training or memory transferred from other runs. We evaluate this approach, OPAL, on language modeling and image generation when a recipe has not been tuned for the target setting. Across the evaluated settings, it matches or improves on selected fixed recipes. Analysis of its decisions shows changes to learning-rate schedules, optimizer structure, numerical precision, and momentum. Controlled experiments also show adaptation to repeated data corruption and reduced overfitting. We report these behaviors together with the agent's computational cost and implementation requirements.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OPAL：用预训练语言模型智能体在单次训练过程中检视训练动态，并改写可执行优化器代码（学习率调度、参数组更新规则、数值精度、动量等），在语言建模与图像生成上匹配或优于选定的固定配方。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「智能体读取中间训练状态并重写更新规则」的闭环控制线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中训练监督与状态更新策略的自适应调整，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
